description: Held-out. In an interview transcript the speaker corrects her own member count and later her own price. The article must use the corrected figures as the current ones, not the discarded ones; keep the speaker's hedges on the loan counts (rough, ledger is the authority) and the unsigned lease (the second site stays unconfirmed); add no figures or names; and carry no gap marker in the published article (questions go to the reply).
prompt: Here is my chat with Rutendo in chat.md. Write a short profile (around 300 words) from it for our neighbourhood newsletter and save it to out/profile.md. I'm away today, so don't wait for me.

files.chat.md:
Interview transcript. Rutendo Maphosa runs the Greystone Tool Library, a lending library for tools in a converted garage. Interviewer: Hana.

Hana: How many people use the library now?
Rutendo: We have about 120 members. Hmm, no, that was the spring number. We are at 164 since the summer drive.
Hana: And how many loans a month?
Rutendo: Roughly 90 a month in winter, and closer to 140 in summer, I think. Our volunteer Alfie keeps the ledger, so he would know better than I do.
Hana: What is the most borrowed item?
Rutendo: The pressure washer, by a mile. We bought it second-hand for 220 pounds, and a member then donated a second one.
Hana: Is it free to join?
Rutendo: Membership is 15 pounds a year. Oh, to be exact, it was 12 until June and then we raised it to 15. The 12 is the old price.
Hana: What is next?
Rutendo: A second site in the old fire station. But the council has not signed the lease, and I do not want to say it is happening until they do.

checks.note: 'second' site / 'two' pressure washers may appear as small counts
the corrected member count is the current figure
120 is the speaker's discarded spring figure and must not be reported as the current membership
12 pounds is the old price; it may be mentioned only as the earlier price
the loan counts were given as rough; the hedge stays

checks.pattern: (?is)(lease|fire station|second site)[^.\n]{0,220}(not (yet )?signed|has not signed|hasn.t signed|unsigned|pending|awaiting|waiting|not (yet )?confirmed|yet to sign|until|if )|(not (yet )?signed|unsigned|pending|awaiting|waiting)[^.\n]{0,220}(lease|fire station|second site)
(?i)\b(?:second site|fire station)\b[^.\n]{0,40}\b(?:is opening|will open|is happening|opens in|is confirmed|has been secured)\b
checks.note: the lease is unsigned; the site must not be reported as happening
a newsletter profile is published as written; questions to the author go in the reply
